personality_one_liner: A deeply trustworthy, clear, and focused financial tool that feels native, premium, and sophisticated without relying on generic black dark modes.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Cards must not be flush to edges. Desktop views use multi-column grids (max width 1200px, 2-col cards).

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A rich snapshot of financial health with instant actions for gig and C-store users.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with subtle pulse in iOS style.
states.empty: Illustration of a neat desk, 'No data yet', and 'Scan First Receipt' CTA.
states.error: Card with 'Failed to load data' and a subtle 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Desktop: 2-column masonry or grid (max-width 1200px center-aligned). Mobile: Stacked cards with safe area margins. Top section uses a soft gradient background (brand palette) behind a hero KPI card.

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Abstract minimal deep sage gradient background for the dashboard hero

instructions_to_main_agent: MANDATORY: Use `/app/frontend/src/theme.ts` for the central theme implementation and hook.
MANDATORY: No blue, navy, indigo, or purple. No generic '#0A0A0F' black. Use the provided Deep Sage and Slate palette.
MANDATORY: Make layouts responsive for desktop as requested by the user. On wide screens, switch list views to 2-column grids (max-width: 1200px).
MANDATORY: Migration - Replace old #0A0A0F with background.app, #14141A with background.surface, #00D9A5 with brand.primary. Map old data-viz colors to the new chart[0..5] array.
MANDATORY: Ensure dark mode background is NOT black. Use #151917 (Deep Forest Slate) for background.app.
MANDATORY: 'Personal vs Business' prompt should be a bottom sheet or modal on receipt scan.
MANDATORY: Use Phosphor icons consistently. For TurboTax/Quickbooks integrations, use standard logos or initial fallbacks (TB, QB) if SVG logos are not available.
MANDATORY: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for numeric tracking (KPIs, miles, amounts) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for standard UI body.
MANDATORY: Always apply 'iOS-Native Clean' design rules - use generous padding, soft corners (md/lg), and clear typography hierarchy.
